# Senior Backend Engineer

## Summary
Backend engineer with 9 years of professional Python. Builds and operates REST APIs and event-driven services on AWS, with PostgreSQL as the main datastore.

## Experience
**Senior Backend Engineer -- Fernhollow Systems (synthetic)** (2020-present)
- Designed and ran Python (FastAPI) REST APIs serving 40k requests a minute on AWS (ECS, Lambda, SQS, S3).
- Owned the PostgreSQL schema and query tuning for the billing service; cut p95 latency by 60%.
- Led on-call and incident reviews for a team of six; wrote the service runbooks.

**Backend Engineer -- Quillmere Labs (synthetic)** (2016-2020)
- Built Python (Django) REST APIs and background workers backed by PostgreSQL and Redis.
- Deployed with Docker and Terraform on AWS; added CI with automated tests.

## Skills
Python, FastAPI, Django, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, Redis, AWS, Docker, Terraform, CI/CD
